source.title: Open problems and new directions for p-modulus on networks

trace.notes: Normalized input as zbMATH record 6980465. The local source index identified the exact work as "Open problems and new directions for p-modulus on networks" with DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-73126-1_10.

Direct zbMATH browser/API access did not expose readable record data in this environment: the web page was not readable through the browser fetch path, the zbMATH API/OAI endpoints presented a terms gate, and local shell DNS for api.zbmath.org was unavailable. The DOI landing page resolved to Springer, which confirmed the exact chapter title, authors Nathan Albin and Pietro Poggi-Corradini, pages 129-141, and the abstract, but exposed only subscription preview/metadata rather than the chapter body.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact identifier and title searches, including the zbMATH ID, the exact DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus first authors, and exact title plus problem terms. Inspected candidates included Springer chapter/book pages, K-State publication metadata, EurekaMag metadata/order page, bookstore/library catalog pages, and a Scribd mirror that returned a JavaScript client challenge. The recovered candidates were metadata-only, abstract-only, paywalled, blocked/challenged, citation/catalog records, or not a source-authorized readable full-text artifact.
